name: mix-ref
description: Mixed-workload baseline REFERENCE round: the total rate is fixed IN THIS FILE on purpose — the baseline key is scenario_env_profile and command-line RATE= is not part of it, so a floating rate would let incomparable rounds share one baseline. Do not override RATE here; probing at other rates belongs to the mix profile.
_baseline: Same doctrine as baseline.json: a measurement round, not a judgment round (apiSla:false; regression detection comes from the promoted-baseline comparison on later mix-ref runs). Promote after 3 stable PASSes: cp <run>/summary.json baselines/trade-mix_<env>_mix-ref.json
_pools: Effective split at rate 4 = query 2/s + create/update/approve 1/s each (floor of 1 lifts the total slightly above nominal). Pool demand per 5m round: update-ids and approve-tasks ~300 planned each -> seed >= 360 per pool (seed ITERATIONS=450 covers harvest dropout). Both pools are dirty after the round — re-seed before rerun.

thresholds._circuitBreaker: Strict line: a reference round with business failures is not promotable. Lenient line + abortOnFail is the shared-environment breaker.
